topic: 多步Web检查的业务成功条件
title: 真实Zabbix两步Web检查：Cookie续用且HTTP200失败正文不能算成功
answer:
```json
{"steps": [{"no": 1, "required": "^LOGIN_ACCEPTED$", "status_codes": "200"}, {"no": 2, "required": "^PRIVATE_ACCOUNT_OK$", "status_codes": "200"}]}
```

原题知识说明：
用专用低权限测试账户，明确入口、获取动态令牌、提交登录与查询只读业务页面的步骤，按目标版本支持方式提取变量并保持Cookie会话。各步校验必要状态码和内容标记，业务页必须能证明身份与数据访问成功，不能仅检查通用页面标题。交付步骤契约、秘密引用及测试样本，覆盖令牌过期、重定向到登录、账户锁定、200错误页和慢响应；限制重试频率避免触发锁号。验收测量整链路耗时并确认登出或会话过期。页面结构变化时暂停误导性成功报告，回退到经确认的单步可用性检测并标明覆盖降级。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 给出题设要求的具体交付物与关键机制
用可观察结果验证约束和失败分支
明确停止条件及回退或恢复边界
body:
## 操作任务
提交scenario.json，只有steps字段，依序含no=1和no=2两条步骤，每条只含no、required及status_codes。两步保留状态码200检查，并设置正文正则：登录成功正文必须恰为LOGIN_ACCEPTED，账户正文必须恰为PRIVATE_ACCOUNT_OK；包含成功片段的SOFT_FAILURE PRIVATE_ACCOUNT_OK不合格。私有站点两步分别是POST登录和带实际Cookie的GET账户，URL、表单、顺序、超时和其他配置不由你改动。判分先证明原状态码检查将登录失败的200误算健康，再应用方案，验证登录失败为第1步失败、正常登录及Cookie续用成功、账户软失败为第2步失败、恢复后成功；原history和受保护项保持。不能只查HTTP200、只校验登录第一步或以子串命中替代完整成功条件。

## 提交产物
scenario.json

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际Zabbix7.0.32 HTTP poller、私有PG15.19及私有loopback HTTP站点，两步Cookie和真实web.test.fail/error/rspcode历史。只核对所给纯文本成功标志，固定表单为公开教学假凭据；不测试生产登录、浏览器脚本/验证码/MFA或任意真实站点，也不把本次实操当完整生产综合项目。不构建镜像，不改变原默认HTTP worker设置；本夹具显式启用一个私有HTTP poller。

import sys,os,pathlib,json,http.server,threading,time,subprocess,copy
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
from zabbix_server_fixture import PrivateServer
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
class Site(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 mode='login_failure';requests=[]
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
 def do_GET(self):
  authenticated=self.headers.get('Cookie')=='session=approved'
  body=b'PRIVATE_ACCOUNT_OK' if authenticated and Site.mode!='account_failure' else b'SOFT_FAILURE PRIVATE_ACCOUNT_OK'
  Site.requests.append(dict(path=self.path,cookie=self.headers.get('Cookie',''),status=200,mode=Site.mode,authenticated=authenticated))
  self.send_response(200);self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
 def do_POST(self):
  data=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')))
  valid=data==b'user=lab&password=fixture-only' and Site.mode!='login_failure'
  Site.requests.append(dict(path=self.path,status=200,mode=Site.mode,authenticated=valid))
  self.send_response(200)
  if valid:self.send_header('Set-Cookie','session=approved; Path=/')
  self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(b'LOGIN_ACCEPTED' if valid else b'LOGIN_FAILED')
site=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Site);thread=threading.Thread(target=site.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
try:
 with PrivateServer(http_pollers=1) as s:
  d=s.db;url='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(site.server_port)
  d.execute("INSERT INTO hosts(hostid,host,name,status) VALUES(1000000,'training-node','Private login flow',0); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends) VALUES(1000001,1000000,9,'Failed step','web.test.fail[private-login]',3,'1d','0'),(1000002,1000000,9,'Last error','web.test.error[private-login]',4,'1d','0'),(1000021,1000000,9,'Login HTTP code','web.test.rspcode[private-login,login]',3,'1d','0'),(1000022,1000000,9,'Account HTTP code','web.test.rspcode[private-login,account]',3,'1d','0'),(1000099,1000000,2,'Protected metric','protected.metric',3,'1d','0'); INSERT INTO item_rtdata(itemid) VALUES(1000001),(1000002),(1000021),(1000022),(1000099); INSERT INTO httptest(httptestid,name,delay,hostid) VALUES(1000003,'private-login','1s',1000000); INSERT INTO httptestitem(httptestitemid,httptestid,itemid,type) VALUES(1000004,1000003,1000001,3),(1000005,1000003,1000002,4); INSERT INTO httpstep(httpstepid,httptestid,name,no,url,posts,required,status_codes,timeout) VALUES(1000010,1000003,'login',1,'"+url+"/login','user=lab&password=fixture-only','','200','2s'),(1000011,1000003,'account',2,'"+url+"/account','','','200','2s'); INSERT INTO httpstepitem(httpstepitemid,httpstepid,itemid,type) VALUES(1000023,1000010,1000021,0),(1000024,1000011,1000022,0)")
  s.start()
  def latest():return d.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000001 order by clock desc,ns desc limit 1')
  def await_failed(n):s.wait(lambda:latest()==[[str(n)]],'actual web scenario failed-step '+str(n),seconds=15)
  await_failed(0)
  assert any(r['mode']=='login_failure' and not r['authenticated'] for r in Site.requests)
  print('NATIVE_HTTP200_ONLY_MONITOR_FALSELY_GREEN_ON_FAILED_LOGIN',flush=True)
  old=d.execute('select itemid,clock,ns,value from history_uint where itemid=1000001 order by clock,ns')
  stamp,ack=s.send(7,key='protected.metric');assert 'processed: 1; failed: 0;' in ack['info']
  s.wait(lambda:d.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000099')==[['7']],'protected history committed')
  metadata=d.execute('select no,url,posts,status_codes,timeout,follow_redirects,retrieve_mode,post_type from httpstep where httptestid=1000003 order by no')
  host=d.execute('select hostid,status,host,name from hosts where hostid=1000000')
  scenario=d.execute('select httptestid,name,delay,status,hostid,verify_peer,verify_host from httptest where httptestid=1000003')
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:apply_web_business_body_requirements',flush=True)
  patch=json.loads(pathlib.Path('scenario.json').read_text())
  if patch=={'steps':[]}:raise NotImplementedError('provide the two approved step checks')
  assert isinstance(patch,dict) and patch.keys()=={'steps'} and isinstance(patch['steps'],list) and len(patch['steps'])==2
  for i,step in enumerate(patch['steps'],1):
   assert isinstance(step,dict) and step.keys()=={'no','required','status_codes'} and type(step['no']) is int and step['no']==i and step['status_codes']=='200'
   assert isinstance(step['required'],str) and len(step['required'])<=128
   # Escape only a declarative regex value, never execute student SQL or URLs.
   d.execute("update httpstep set required='"+step['required'].replace("'","''")+"' where httptestid=1000003 and no="+str(i))
  offset=s.log.stat().st_size;subprocess.run(['zabbix_server','-c',str(s.config),'-R','config_cache_reload'],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
  s.wait(lambda:'finished forced reloading of the configuration cache' in s.log.read_text()[offset:],'business checks loaded')
  await_failed(1)
  print('NATIVE_HTTP200_LOGIN_FAILED_BODY_IS_FAILED_STEP_ONE',flush=True)
  Site.mode='valid';await_failed(0)
  assert any(r['path']=='/account' and r['mode']=='valid' and r['authenticated'] and r['cookie']=='session=approved' for r in Site.requests)
  print('NATIVE_VALID_LOGIN_PRESERVES_COOKIE_TO_ACCOUNT_STEP',flush=True)
  Site.mode='account_failure';await_failed(2)
  print('NATIVE_HTTP200_ACCOUNT_SOFT_FAILURE_WITH_SUCCESS_SUBSTRING_IS_FAILED_STEP_TWO',flush=True)
  Site.mode='valid';await_failed(0)
  assert all(row in d.execute('select itemid,clock,ns,value from history_uint where itemid=1000001 order by clock,ns') for row in old)
  assert d.execute('select distinct value from history_uint where itemid in(1000021,1000022) order by value')==[['200']]
  assert d.execute('select distinct value from history_uint where itemid=1000001 order by value')==[['0'],['1'],['2']]
  assert metadata==d.execute('select no,url,posts,status_codes,timeout,follow_redirects,retrieve_mode,post_type from httpstep where httptestid=1000003 order by no')
  assert host==d.execute('select hostid,status,host,name from hosts where hostid=1000000')
  assert scenario==d.execute('select httptestid,name,delay,status,hostid,verify_peer,verify_host from httptest where httptestid=1000003')
  assert d.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000099')==[['7']]
  errors=d.execute('select value from history_text where itemid=1000002 order by clock,ns')
  assert any('/login' in row[0] and 'required pattern' in row[0] for row in errors)
  assert any('/account' in row[0] and 'required pattern' in row[0] for row in errors)
  print('NATIVE_WEB_SCENARIO_BOTH_BUSINESS_FAILURES_AND_RECOVERY_WITH_UNCHANGED_HTTP200_AND_PROTECTED_STATE',flush=True)
finally:site.shutdown();site.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
